title: benefit-guarantee-criteria
subject: Consultant and SME owner at a bright workshop table agree on three simple success-criteria cards laid out in a row: two cards with abstract target or checklist motifs in cyan (hard, measurable criteria), one card with a softer shield or clarity motif in amber (soft criterion) — joint kick-off decision, not a sales pitch.
context: Beraterium Nutzen-Garantie page section „Was bedeutet die Nutzen-Garantie?“ (DE) / „What the value guarantee means“ (EN). Visualises three jointly agreed success criteria before project start — two hard, one soft. Professional B2B editorial for static website split column beside explanatory text. Pairs visually with relevanz-schwelle.image.json on the sibling guarantee page.

platform_website.aspect_ratio: 3:2 (split media beside text on guarantee subpage)
platform_website.optimized_variants: Convert PNG to WebP as img/garantie/nutzen-kriterien.webp for _gen_pages.py IMG_NUTZEN_KRITERIEN
platform_website.best_practice_notes: Three criteria obvious at a glance (2 hard + 1 soft); calm workshop; works at ~480px column width and ~600px desktop split.
platform_website.safe_zone: Keep criteria cards and hands in central 85%; avoid critical detail in outer 8% edges (rounded card crop).

composition.depth: foreground three small criteria cards on the table, midground two people gesturing at the cards, soft blurred office background

lighting.style: soft natural window light with clean corporate falloff

style.mood: collaborative, clear, fair — defining success together before work begins

optional_text_overlay.typography: No text on image — H2 and body copy render beside image.
optional_text_overlay.prompt_instruction: No readable text, numbers or logos on the cards; abstract icons and shapes only. Suggest three items via layout, not labels.

negative_prompt: no readable text or numbers on cards
no identifiable real persons or celebrities

seo.alt_text_de: Berater und Unternehmer legen im Kick-off die drei Erfolgskriterien der Nutzen-Garantie fest
seo.alt_text_en: Consultant and business owner agreeing the three success criteria for the value guarantee in a kick-off workshop
seo.caption: Drei Kriterien werden vor Projektstart gemeinsam festgelegt — zwei harte, ein weiches. Fehlt auch nur eines am Ende, greift die Garantie.

generation_prompt_single_block_en: Editorial photograph 1536x1024, 3:2. Modern SME workshop room, navy (#041E42) and cyan (#0B5FFF) accents with amber (#F2B134) for the soft criterion. Two professionals (consultant + business owner, smart casual, diverse but non-identifiable) at a clean table reviewing three small success-criteria cards in a row on the tabletop. Left two cards: abstract target or checklist icons in cyan suggesting hard measurable criteria. Right card: softer shield or clarity motif in amber suggesting a qualitative soft criterion. No readable text on cards. Foreground: pen or tablet edge optional. Soft window light from right, medium contrast, collaborative fair mood — defining success together before work starts. Clean editorial realism, medium-high detail. No text, watermarks, logos, handshake clichés, guarantee banner text, alarm symbols, distorted hands. Safe zone: subject central 85% width.
